claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Sertaconazole is an imidazole antifungal that inhibits fungal sterol demethylase; at 2.5 uM in human cancer cells it is expected to be largely inactive, with any killing attributable to nonspecific cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic membrane effects at high concentration rather than a defined anticancer mechanism.
